keyFindings.description: N1, introduced by d4d3d793. revokeUnless now keeps an unanswered revoked entry, and answer takes the first unanswered entry, revoked or not. Order: newer page admitted, then older, both writable; the newer one is revoked; the older page's token takes the revoked entry; the newer socket's ServeHTTP removes it. The older page's own entry then stays unanswered and writable, so admit refuses every read-only socket of that key (room, schema_version), the revoked page's own reconnect included, for as long as the older page is open. Both subagents reproduced it with a scratch test, which fails at 74666d32 and passes at 377d5a49. Fix: answer prefers an entry that is not revoked, and falls back to a revoked one only when none waits. Add the newer-first test, failing first.

The test's 'nothing after the close frame' checks run after conn.Close(), so they pass without the closed guard. Call closeBetweenMessages directly, then assert that Write returns net.ErrClosed and that the page reads nothing after the 1012 frame.
